name: indexx-instagram-skill
description: Export Instagram Saved post IDs through your browser sidebar or agent, with resumable checkpoints and JSON, CSV, and text output.

interface.shortDescription: Export IDs from your Instagram Saved grid.
interface.longDescription: Use the browser extension or agent sidebar to collect accessible Instagram Saved IDs and deliver JSON, CSV, and text exports. Uses the host's browser, JavaScript, checkpoint, and download tools; no Python or terminal setup is needed.
defaultPrompt: Export the IDs from my Instagram Saved All posts grid.
